title: Model Context Protocol
before: Every tool integration was written per model and per application.
problem: Connecting M models to N tools means M times N bespoke integrations.
breakthrough: An open protocol for exposing tools, data and prompts to any model, so each side implements it once.
why: It turned tool connectivity into shared infrastructure, and was adopted across the industry within a year.
next: Adopted by other labs and the agent tooling ecosystem through 2025 and 2026.
inherits: A common protocol between models and the systems they act on.
